name: search_tracks
description: This tool belongs to the SpotifyAPI, which provides functionality for music streaming including searching tracks, managing playlists, and getting personalized recommendations. Tool description: Search for tracks by name or artist.

name: search_playlists
description: This tool belongs to the SpotifyAPI, which provides functionality for music streaming including searching tracks, managing playlists, and getting personalized recommendations. Tool description: Search for playlists by name or description.

name: get_playlist
description: This tool belongs to the SpotifyAPI, which provides functionality for music streaming including searching tracks, managing playlists, and getting personalized recommendations. Tool description: Get details of a specific playlist including its tracks.

playlist_id.description: ID of the playlist to retrieve.

tracks.description: List of track dictionaries in the playlist.

name: create_playlist
description: This tool belongs to the SpotifyAPI, which provides functionality for music streaming including searching tracks, managing playlists, and getting personalized recommendations. Tool description: Create a new playlist.

name: add_track_to_playlist
description: This tool belongs to the SpotifyAPI, which provides functionality for music streaming including searching tracks, managing playlists, and getting personalized recommendations. Tool description: Add a track to a playlist.

track_id.description: ID of the track to add.

add_status.description: True if the track was added successfully.

name: remove_track_from_playlist
description: This tool belongs to the SpotifyAPI, which provides functionality for music streaming including searching tracks, managing playlists, and getting personalized recommendations. Tool description: Remove a track from a playlist.

track_id.description: ID of the track to remove.

remove_status.description: True if the track was removed successfully.

name: get_track_details
description: This tool belongs to the SpotifyAPI, which provides functionality for music streaming including searching tracks, managing playlists, and getting personalized recommendations. Tool description: Get details of a specific track.

name: get_recently_played
description: This tool belongs to the SpotifyAPI, which provides functionality for music streaming including searching tracks, managing playlists, and getting personalized recommendations. Tool description: Get the user's recently played tracks.

limit.description: [Optional] Maximum number of tracks to return. Default 10.

tracks.description: List of recently played track dictionaries.

name: get_user_playlists
description: This tool belongs to the SpotifyAPI, which provides functionality for music streaming including searching tracks, managing playlists, and getting personalized recommendations. Tool description: Get the current user's playlists.

playlists.description: List of the user's playlist dictionaries.

name: get_recommendations
description: This tool belongs to the SpotifyAPI, which provides functionality for music streaming including searching tracks, managing playlists, and getting personalized recommendations. Tool description: Get track recommendations based on seed tracks.

seed_track_ids.description: List of track IDs to use as seeds.

name: save_playlist
description: This tool belongs to the SpotifyAPI, which provides functionality for music streaming including searching tracks, managing playlists, and getting personalized recommendations. Tool description: Save a playlist to the user's library.

playlist_id.description: ID of the playlist to save.

save_status.description: True if saved successfully, False if already saved.
